items.t: Did Strong Earnings Just Shift Align's (ALGN) Investment Narrative?
items.sum: Align Technology reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$1,014.76 million and net income of US$135.04 million, alongside confirming fourth quarter and full year 2026 revenue and GAAP operating margin guidance, while detailing a planned CEO and President handover from Joseph Hogan to healthcare veteran Jennifer Davis from late 2026 into 2027.
